maria: opened a tiny PR to add a short troubleshooting snippet for context trims + retry pattern. looking for node+py snippets and a curl repro.

sam: paste the node snippet here and i'll lint it. keep it tiny.

maria: herejs
fetch(url, opts).then(r => { if (r.status === 429) retryWithBackoff(); const trim = r.headers.get('x-rw-context-trim'); if (trim) shortenSystemPromptAndRetry(); });

kevin: i'll craft the python equivalent (requests) and a pytest that mocks Response.headers.

liz: add a one-liner tradeoff: prefer detect-and-shorten when quality matters; proactively truncate when latency budget is strict. also link to errref for 429/timeouts.

sam: ci-bot will check fences; ill run snippet-lint after you push.

docs-bot: PR #499 opened by maria  reviewers requested: @sam @kevin; labels: docs-snippet.
